pokemon_scp.name: Spearow
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0021 is to be housed in a small aviary with reinforced mesh and directional microphones. Personnel must avoid sudden movements and loud noises. Feeding is to be conducted via automated dispensers.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0021 is a small avian organism capable of producing high‑frequency screeches that disrupt short‑range communication devices. Wing musculature allows rapid darting movements, making capture difficult.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Displays erratic flight patterns and aggressive pecking behavior when startled. Often attempts to intimidate larger organisms.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0021-A: SCP-0021’s screech disabled two handheld radios during a containment check.
Addendum 0021-B: Behavioral analysis suggests SCP-0021 uses sound bursts to coordinate territorial displays.

pokemon_scp.name: Fearow
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0022 is to be contained in a large aerial dome with reinforced steel supports. Personnel must not enter during flight cycles. Emergency nets and tranquilizer drones must remain on standby.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0022 is a large avian organism with a razor‑sharp beak capable of penetrating armored plating. It can maintain extended high‑speed flight and dive‑bomb targets with lethal precision.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Highly territorial and aggressive. Displays complex aerial maneuvers and attempts to strike at perceived weak points in containment.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0022-A: SCP-0022 pierced a reinforced barrier during a dive attack.
Addendum 0022-B: Wingbeat analysis suggests SCP-0022 can generate localized shockwaves.

pokemon_scp.name: Ekans
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0023 is to be contained in a serpentine enclosure with toxin‑resistant flooring. Personnel must avoid direct contact and use snake hooks for repositioning.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0023 is a serpentine organism capable of producing venom with paralytic and hallucinogenic properties. It can unhinge its jaw to an anomalous degree, allowing ingestion of objects larger than expected.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: SCP-0023 is stealthy and prefers to coil in dark corners. Shows interest in electrical vibrations and often approaches active wiring.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0023-A: SCP-0023 consumed a monitoring device whole, causing a temporary data blackout.
Addendum 0023-B: Venom samples show adaptive chemical signatures based on prey species.

pokemon_scp.name: Arbok
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0024 is to be contained in a reinforced pit chamber with vertical escape‑proof walls. Personnel must maintain a minimum distance of 10 meters. Venom extraction requires remote‑operated tools.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0024 is a large serpentine organism with a hood displaying bioluminescent patterns. These patterns induce fear responses and temporary paralysis in observers. SCP-0024’s constriction force exceeds industrial hydraulic presses.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Extremely aggressive. Uses hood patterns to immobilize prey before striking.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0024-A: A guard exposed to SCP-0024’s hood pattern experienced vivid hallucinations of predatory pursuit.
Addendum 0024-B: SCP-0024 shattered a reinforced barrier during a constriction event.

pokemon_scp.name: Pikachu
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0025 is to be contained in an insulated chamber with Faraday shielding. Personnel must avoid provoking SCP-0025 during charge buildup cycles.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0025 is a small rodent capable of generating electrical discharges exceeding 300 volts. Cheek sacs store bioelectric energy that can be released in controlled bursts.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Playful but unpredictable. Electrical output increases when SCP-0025 is excited or threatened.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0025-A: SCP-0025 overloaded a containment sensor array during a play session.
Addendum 0025-B: SCP-0025 appears capable of detecting electromagnetic fields.

pokemon_scp.name: Raichu
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0026 is to be contained in a reinforced Faraday vault with triple‑layer grounding. Personnel must wear insulated suits during interaction.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0026 can generate electrical discharges exceeding 50,000 volts. Tail acts as a conductive whip capable of slicing through metal when electrified.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Displays aggressive dominance behavior. Electrical surges occur unpredictably.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0026-A: SCP-0026 caused a facility‑wide blackout lasting 12 minutes.
Addendum 0026-B: Tail strikes show patterns consistent with deliberate targeting.

pokemon_scp.name: Sandshrew
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0027 is to be housed in a desert‑simulation enclosure with loose soil. Digging activity must be monitored via ground‑penetrating radar.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0027 is a small burrowing organism with a tough hide resistant to abrasion. Capable of tunneling through compacted earth at high speed.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Docile and prefers solitude. Engages in frequent burrowing.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0027-A: SCP-0027 created a tunnel network forming a near‑perfect spiral.
Addendum 0027-B: Hide samples show mineral integration similar to sandstone.

pokemon_scp.name: Sandslash
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0028 is to be contained in a reinforced burrowing chamber with steel mesh flooring. Personnel must avoid proximity to SCP-0028’s claws.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0028 possesses hardened mineral claws capable of slicing through reinforced concrete. Spines on its back can be launched as projectiles.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Aggressive when disturbed. Uses rapid spinning attacks to defend territory.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0028-A: SCP-0028’s spines penetrated a containment barrier during testing.
Addendum 0028-B: Claw samples show crystalline growth patterns.

pokemon_scp.name: Nidoran♀
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0029 is to be kept in a toxin‑neutralizing enclosure. Personnel must avoid contact with SCP-0029’s horn.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0029 is a small mammalian organism with a venomous horn. Venom causes mild paralysis and nausea.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Timid and avoids confrontation. Displays protective behavior toward familiar personnel.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0029-A: SCP-0029’s venom potency increases during stress.
Addendum 0029-B: SCP-0029 emitted a distress call that attracted SCP-0030.

pokemon_scp.name: Nidorina
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0030 is to be contained in a reinforced mammalian chamber. Personnel must avoid provoking SCP-0030’s defensive lunges.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0030 is a larger mammalian organism with reduced venom output compared to SCP-0029. Displays enhanced physical strength and protective instincts.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Highly protective of SCP-0029. Shows aggression when SCP-0029 is threatened.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0030-A: SCP-0030 broke a containment barrier while attempting to reach SCP-0029.
Addendum 0030-B: SCP-0030’s horn shows signs of regrowth after damage.
